_driveFromHostThread: Whether the five driving calls (GoToPoint, Sprint, LookToPoint, Shoot, and the self-actions) may be made from the host's own thread on a host whose onMainThread drain has never fired. When the drain has fired they are queued and executed on Unity's thread regardless, which is what they need. Set false to withhold them instead: bots then decide and do not move, which is the safe direction and the visibly broken one. Either way /sain/status and the log say which path the session took.
_selfTestRuntime: Only read on the sim side, by the binding self-test. Points at a runtime implementing the IL2CPP C API so that client/live.nim can be exercised with no game: tests/mockil2cpp builds one. Remove it and the self-test reports that every binding refused for want of a runtime, which is also a correct answer.
